title: Success-Based Optimization Algorithm (SBOA): Development and enhancement of a metaheuristic optimizer
Gradient-based optimizer: A new metaheuristic optimization algorithm
Natural Convection Optimizer: A Novel Physics-Based Metaheuristic Optimization Algorithm
abstract: In this paper, Natural Convection Optimizer Algorithm (NCvO) is proposed as a novel physical-inspired metaheuristic optimization algorithm. It is a novel physics-inspired metaheuristic optimization algorithm based on natural convection phenomena in fluid dynamics. By simulating the heat transfer process in fluids, NCvO achieves a balanced exploration and exploitation of complex search spaces. We validate NCvO through three experiments: solving the CEC 2017 benchmark in 10 dimensions and comparing results with well-established metaheuristics using statistical analyses like Wilcoxon and Friedman tests. NCvO demonstrates superior performance in terms of average fitness values and objective function evaluations, establishing its potential as a robust optimization tool.
